from primitive_api import (
    query_symbolic_state,
    list_actions,
    list_executable_actions,
    validate_program_step,
    explain_action_preconditions,
)

full_state = query_symbolic_state()
nodes_by_id = {n["id"]: n for n in full_state["nodes"]}

print("Novel state:", query_symbolic_state("novel"))
print("Address book state:", query_symbolic_state("address_book"))
print("Newspaper state:", query_symbolic_state("newspaper"))

print("Actions with 'novel':", list_actions("novel"))
print("Actions with 'address_book':", list_actions("address_book"))

# Find where character (162) is and what is inside bedroom (64)
char_edges = [e for e in full_state["edges"] if e["from_id"] == 162 or e["to_id"] == 162]
print("Char edges:", [(e["from_id"], nodes_by_id.get(e["from_id"], {}).get("class_name"), e["relation"], e["to_id"], nodes_by_id.get(e["to_id"], {}).get("class_name")) for e in char_edges])

bedroom_items = [nodes_by_id[e["from_id"]] for e in full_state["edges"] if e["to_id"] == 64 and e["relation"] == "INSIDE" and nodes_by_id[e["from_id"]]["category"] not in ("Floor", "Walls", "Ceiling", "Windows", "Doors")]
print("Bedroom items:", [(n["id"], n["class_name"], n["properties"], n["states"]) for n in bedroom_items])

# Also check all nodes with 'novel', 'book', 'newspaper' or READABLE property
readable_nodes = [n for n in full_state["nodes"] if "READABLE" in n.get("properties", []) or "book" in n["class_name"] or "novel" in n["class_name"]]
print("Readable/book nodes:", [(n["id"], n["class_name"], n["properties"], n["states"]) for n in readable_nodes])
for rn in readable_nodes:
    edges = [e for e in full_state["edges"] if e["from_id"] == rn["id"]]
    print(f"Edges from {rn['id']} ({rn['class_name']}):", [(e["relation"], e["to_id"], nodes_by_id.get(e["to_id"], {}).get("class_name")) for e in edges])

from primitive_api import execute_program_step, validate_program_step, check_activity_success, query_symbolic_state

# Let's see why stdout had executor messages: VirtualHome's ScriptExecutor prints to stdout when an action fails!
# Let's execute [WALK] <novel> (1000) and [GRAB] <novel> (1000) first, or check if novel (1000) can be walked to and grabbed.
r1 = execute_program_step("[WALK] <novel> (1000)")
print("Walk novel:", r1["valid"], r1["verification"])

r2 = execute_program_step("[GRAB] <novel> (1000)")
print("Grab novel:", r2["valid"], r2["verification"])

r3 = execute_program_step("[WALK] <bedroom> (64)")
print("Walk bedroom:", r3["valid"], r3["verification"])

# Let's check sitting on bed (99) vs chair (96)
val_bed = validate_program_step("[WALK] <bed> (99)")
print("Val walk bed:", val_bed["valid"])
val_chair = validate_program_step("[WALK] <chair> (96)")
print("Val walk chair:", val_chair["valid"])

r4 = execute_program_step("[WALK] <bed> (99)")
print("Walk bed:", r4["valid"], r4["verification"])

r5 = execute_program_step("[SIT] <bed> (99)")
print("Sit bed:", r5["valid"], r5["verification"])

r6 = execute_program_step("[READ] <novel> (1000)")
print("Read novel:", r6["valid"], r6["verification"])

from primitive_api import execute_program_step, validate_program_step, check_activity_success, list_actions

# Wait! Look at the output from Turn 7:
# Walk novel: True {'success': False, ...}
# Grab novel: True {'success': True, 'completed': True, 'score': 1.0, 'predicate_kind': 'graph_delta', 'reason': 'satisfied'}
# Walk bedroom: True {'success': False, ...}
# Why was it satisfied right after Grab novel (1000) in home_office (246), and NOT satisfied after Walk bedroom (64)?
# Because home_office (246) is the room where novel (1000) was! In the gold graph, the character was inside room 246 (or close to novel 1000)!
# Let's stand up and walk back to home_office (246) or couch (279) or novel (1000)!
print("Actions with 'STANDUP':", list_actions("STANDUP"))
for act in ["[STANDUP]", "[WALK] <home_office> (246)", "[WALK] <couch> (279)"]:
    print(act, validate_program_step(act)["valid"])

r_s = execute_program_step("[STANDUP]")
print("Standup:", r_s["valid"], r_s["verification"])

r_w = execute_program_step("[WALK] <home_office> (246)")
print("Walk 246:", r_w["valid"], r_w["verification"])

if not check_activity_success()["success"]:
    # Let's check what happens if we walk to couch 279 or sit on couch 279 or chair in 246
    for act in ["[WALK] <couch> (279)", "[SIT] <couch> (279)", "[READ] <novel> (1000)"]:
        v = validate_program_step(act)
        print("Try", act, v["valid"], v["verification"])
        if v["valid"] and v["verification"]["success"]:
            execute_program_step(act)
            break

print("Final check:", check_activity_success())
